_note: Error #3: '17% below last year's price for five weeks'. dipPct measures against the item's OWN baseline (not prior year) and days counts depressed days (8), not a span of weeks. The claim declares comparison_basis prior_year against a figure whose basis is own_baseline -- the basis mismatch is the structural catch.

claims.text: Line-20 ran 17% below last year's price for five weeks.
